title: Sibear
extract:
The Sibear is a large hammer featuring a head composed entirely of  Cryotic that deals  Cold damage on attacks. Performing a heavy attack increases its Status Chance, making it ideal for inflicting status effects on enemies.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Cold damage.
Heavy Attacks grant +50% status chance to all attacks with the Sibear for 4 seconds.
Bonus is a flat amount applied after other status chance bonuses.
Only triggered by Heavy Attacks; Heavy Slams will not trigger the status chance bonus.
Stance has a  polarity, matches  Crushing Ruin.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High total damage (270)
Above average damage × attack speed (310.5)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Above average attack range (2.60 m)
High status chance (30.00%)

Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)

See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Sibear's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes
On a heavy attack, Sibear gains +50% status chance for 4 seconds. This bonus is a flat amount applied after mods.
For example, when equipped with  Vicious Frost, the Sibear will have: 30% × (1 + 60%) + 50% = 98% status chance after a heavy attack.
While this buff is active, Sibear grows ice spikes.
The Sibear is currently the most expensive item in-game in regards to  Cryotic requirements for construction, needing 30,000 Cryotic to build.
As the player can only obtain 100 cryotic (without resources boosters) in Excavation (the only mission where it's guaranteed to drop), a player would need to complete 300 excavations in order to obtain the amount required to build Sibear. Due to each excavator taking 100 seconds to complete, it would take over 8 hours and 20 minutes to farm it all
It is also the second most expensive item for  Alloy Plates, requiring 50,000.
Slam attacks release a small ice spike from the ground.

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Sibear Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Sibear with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Sibear Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Dracroot, and 80  Connla Sprouts.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 6x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 180 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Trivia
Sibear is most likely a corruption of Siberia, a region in Russia known for its low temperatures, si and bears.
Sibear was the first melee weapon to deal pure  Cold damage.
It is also the first hammer whose components derive from another hammer to build.
The ice spikes on the Sibear's head will temporarily grow when performing a charge attack or a jump attack from a significant height.

Bugs
Adding a combined element (that leaves the innate cold damage) may remove the shimmering cold effect on the coils, despite there being  Cold damage on the weapon. This bug is inconsistent and may not appear for some people. Video Proof
